verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens for programmatic access. It also ships an official CLI (ldcli) and an official MCP server, local and hosted, which let agents and scripts drive flags, targeting and rollouts programmatically. The probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard candidate paths, but that only means the spec is not at those URLs; it does not contradict that a documented API exists. Missing for 10: a direct API reference page in the evidence, a discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of the management API.
